evidence: src/infrastructure/InMemoryTaskRepository.ts: class InMemoryTaskRepository implements TaskRepository (the domain port) and keeps tasks in a private Map<string, Task>.
save(task) only calls this.tasks.set(task.id, task). It does not validate the task or check any domain invariant.
findByProjectIdAndStatus and findByProjectIdAndAssignee only filter by equality on fields, matching the query each method name describes. They make no business decisions.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: InMemoryTaskRepository is an infrastructure persistence adapter that implements the domain TaskRepository port. Each method handles storage and retrieval only: save puts a task in a Map, findById looks one up, and the find* methods filter by query criteria (projectId, status, assignee). These filters are basic query predicates that match the repository interface's method names. They don't enforce business rules, invariants or state transitions, so persistence logic is the file's only responsibility, which fits the infrastructure layer.
